<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.querySelector('.brutal-page');
  const btn = document.querySelector('.brutal-theme-btn');
  const menu = document.querySelector('.brutal-theme-menu');
  if (!root || !btn || !menu) return;

  const labels = {
    cream: 'Cream', mono: 'Mono', earth: 'Earth',
    carbon: 'Carbon', forest: 'Forest', midnight: 'Midnight',
    noir: 'Noir', neon: 'Neon', vapor: 'Vapor'
  };
  const nameEl = btn.querySelector('.name');

  function apply(theme) {
    if (!labels[theme]) theme = 'cream';
    root.dataset.theme = theme;
    nameEl.textContent = labels[theme];
    menu.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => {
      li.dataset.active = String(li.dataset.theme === theme);
    });
    try { localStorage.setItem('brutal-theme', theme); } catch (e) {}
  }

  let saved = 'cream';
  try { saved = localStorage.getItem('brutal-theme') || 'cream'; } catch (e) {}
  apply(saved);

  btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const open = !menu.hidden;
    menu.hidden = open;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!open));
  });

  menu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const li = e.target.closest('li[data-theme]');
    if (!li) return;
    apply(li.dataset.theme);
    menu.hidden = true;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    menu.hidden = true;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      menu.hidden = true;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // --- Scroll animations via IntersectionObserver ---
  const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  if (!prefersReduced) {
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]');
    if (revealEls.length) {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries) => {
          entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting && !entry.target.classList.contains('revealed')) {
              entry.target.classList.add('revealed');
              observer.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        },
        { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' }
      );
      revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
    }
  } else {
    // No animation: reveal everything immediately
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(el => el.classList.add('revealed'));
  }
})();
</script>
